hypothesis_statement: Under heterogeneous model zoos with architecture-specific encoders (NFN/UNF), hierarchical pooling, and Transformer sequence modeling, if we train the 3-level VAE with contrastive supervision, then same-task different-architecture models will exhibit: (1) Task-invariant weight patterns at layer-summary level, (2) Higher CKA similarity (>0.6) than different-task pairs (<0.4), (3) Tighter clustering (lower WCSS) in latent space, (4) Successful cross-architecture relational discovery via self-attention
rationale: Task constraints dominate architecture-specific implementation details at coarse-grained scale

dataset.name: ModelZooDataset (CIFAR-10 Subset)
dataset.format: Preprocessed PyTorch .pt files with vectorized weights

baselines.name: Architecture-Conditioned MLP
baselines.purpose: Test whether architecture labels alone predict clustering (null hypothesis control)

baselines.name: NFN-only (Single Architecture)
baselines.purpose: Validate that NFN works within-architecture before cross-architecture extension
baselines.evaluation_metric: Reconstruction accuracy on held-out CNN-small models (>70%)

baselines.name: CKA Direct Comparison (No VAE)
baselines.purpose: Measure upper bound of CKA similarity without VAE compression
baselines.method: Compute CKA directly on raw vectorized weights
baselines.evaluation_metric: Raw CKA scores for same-task vs different-task pairs

implementation_phases.goal: Validate architecture subspaces are metrically compatible before VAE training
implementation_phases.gate_criterion: If same-task CKA <0.5 OR different-task CKA >0.5, STOP (Risk R5 realized)

implementation_phases.goal: Measure WCSS clustering and ablation tests

tests.method: 100 resamples with same-task vs random-cluster WCSS

phase4_wcss_test.interpretation: Task constraints create tighter clustering than architecture patterns

phase4_reconstruction.interpretation: Pooling retains sufficient task-relevant information (Risk R3 mitigated)

failure_cases.action: STOP - architecture subspaces incompatible, cross-architecture bridge infeasible
failure_cases.next_step: Pivot to homogeneous subsets (CNN-only or ResNet-only)

failure_cases.action: STOP - task structure doesn't exist at coarse-grained scale
failure_cases.next_step: Return to Phase 2A dialogue, explore alternative mechanisms

risks.name: Insufficient Dataset Coverage
risks.status: No additional action needed (72.2% coverage validated)

risks.name: Noisy Task Labels
risks.mitigation: Zero-shot transfer validation (train without task labels, evaluate clustering on held-out models). Success criterion: >85% accuracy. If fails: Pivot to unsupervised contrastive learning.

risks.name: Information Loss in Pooling
risks.mitigation: If degradation 30-50%: Replace mean pooling with Set Transformer. If >50%: ABORT - pooling fundamentally incompatible.

risks.name: Training Procedure Confound
risks.mitigation: Explicit ablation comparing same-task different-procedure vs different-task same-procedure. Test: Does same-augmentation clustering dominate same-task clustering? If procedure effect >60%: Add training-procedure as controlled variable.

risks.name: Architecture Subspace Incompatibility
risks.mitigation: Phase 1 CKA feasibility gate. Gate criterion: same-task CKA >0.6 AND different-task CKA <0.4. If fails: Try nonlinear alignment (RBF kernel CKA), scope reduction (CNN-MLP pairs only). If CKA <0.4: ABORT.

early_stop_opportunities: Week 2: CKA gate fails → Stop before expensive VAE training (saves 4 weeks)
Week 5: WCSS gate fails → Documented failure, return to Phase 2A

primary_must_work_gate: Phase 4: Mean WCSS(same-task) < Mean WCSS(different-task) with p<0.01 and Cohen's d>0.5
secondary_validation: Ablation: Removing architecture tokens degrades clustering ≥15pp
Reconstruction: Task accuracy from pooled representations >70%
tertiary_risk_mitigation: Zero-shot transfer: >85% accuracy on unlabeled models (validates task label quality)
Training procedure ablation: Procedure effect <60% (disentangles task vs optimization)

deliverables: Phase 1 Report: CKA feasibility results, architecture compatibility matrix
Phase 2-3 Checkpoint: Trained hierarchical VAE (50 GB file)
Phase 4 Validation Report: WCSS bootstrap results, ablation analysis, reconstruction accuracy
Code Repository: Fully documented implementation with README, requirements.txt
Visualization Notebook: UMAP plots, CKA heatmaps, clustering comparison
